work.title: The Tale of Jemima Puddle-Duck
work.note: The Tale of Jemima Puddle-Duck é um livro infantil escrito e ilustrado por Beatrix Potter, publicado pela Frederick Warne em julho de 1908. A pata Jemima, cansada de ter seus ovos levados pela esposa do fazendeiro, procura um lugar sossegado para chocá-los e confia em um raposo de maneiras muito elegantes. A aula parte dessa referência para transformar comparar cores: This shirt is darker than mine. That one is brigh

facts.big: How many? · How much? · How long?
facts.label: Quantidade no passado
facts.sub: Use how many com plural, how much com incontável e how long com duração. Combine com o passado: How many people came? How much food did you make?

facts.label: How many
facts.sub: Use how many com coisas que você conta: people, pizzas, chairs. Pergunte How many people came? Responda com número: about thirty. About quer dizer mais ou menos.

facts.label: How much
facts.sub: Use how much com coisas que você não conta: food, water, money. Pergunte How much food did you make? Responda: not enough, a lot, a little.

pages.title: A tidy café · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Sunday afternoon in a tidy café in Portland. Sunlight falls on a small wooden table. Zed waits with a notebook and a pen. His friend Leo walks in, tired but happy. There are balloons in his bag. Zed asks about the party.
“Leo! How many people came to your party?” says Zed. “About thirty. More than I thought!” says Leo. “Wow. How much food did you make?” says Zed.
